meta.description: Spreads points along paths, where branch_from_points and instance_from_points place branches or instances.

plant.description: The paths to place the points on.

amount.description: How many points to place on every path.

lowest_point.description: Where the first point sits. 0 is the bottom, 1 is the top.

highest_point.description: Where the last point sits. 0 is the bottom, 1 is the top.

rotation.description: How far every point is turned around the path from the one before it, in degrees. 180 alternates sides, 137.5 makes a spiral.

offset_single.description: Moves every second point up toward the next one, 1 makes pairs.

depth.description: On how many of the deepest layers of paths to place points.
